A governed research agent (Gemini 2.5 Flash, free tier) that researched, adversarially verified, and human-audited 100 SaaS APIs across 10 categories — using the Composio SDK for tool integration. Findings first, table second, proof third.

4 · The Agent & Governance Layer

🔍 DuckDuckGo search + hint-aware URL scoring→ 🔒 Governed fetch (SSRF guard, robots.txt, HTTPS-only)→ 🤖 Gemini 2.5 Flash structured extraction→ 🚫 Confidence gate (threshold = 0.70)→ ⚔️ Verifier LLM (adversarial re-check every citation)→ 📦 Canonical DB (apps.json)→ 👥 Human sample audit (20 apps, 80 fields)

A policy engine (governance.yaml) intercepts every LLM call (model allowlist, RPM + budget caps), every URL fetch (HTTPS-only, SSRF guard, robots.txt honoured), and every output row (secret scan, PII redaction, quarantine queue), writing a hash-chained audit log you can verify independently:

python scripts/verify_audit.py                           # check audit chain integrity

# Run the pipeline:
python scripts/run_pipeline.py                           # full run  (needs GEMINI_API_KEY in .env)
python scripts/run_pipeline.py --mock --limit 5         # offline dry-run  (0 LLM calls)
python scripts/run_pipeline.py --only 1,2,3             # selective app IDs
python scripts/run_pipeline.py --export-sample          # generate human-audit template
python scripts/run_pipeline.py --score data/audit/human-labels.yml  # score accuracy

Where a human was needed: (1) manually curated the 100-app canonical seed dataset with evidence URLs; (2) wrote the 20-app ground-truth labels for the human audit; (3) spot-checked 11 agent misses and confirmed/rejected them.
